tools.name: search_frames
tools.description: Search the FrameThrower cinematography reference library by concept, mood, color, composition, or scene. Returns reference frames with film/credits metadata, a preview thumbnail, the full-resolution image URL (use this one for slide decks and documents), a precomputed DEPTH MAP url (greyscale, same

tools.name: find_by_craft
tools.description: Find frames by specific cinematography craft attributes — lens character, shot size, visual style, setting, time of day, director, or year range. All optional; combine to narrow. Use this to refine a search precisely.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find frames visually/semantically similar to a given frame id (from a prior result). Use this to pull more references like one the user shortlisted.

tools.name: get_frame_details
tools.description: Get the full metadata + preview thumbnail + full-resolution image URL + depth map URL + link for a single frame id. The depth map is precomputed and free — use it when the user is generating images and needs the composition or camera geometry of this frame.

tools.name: similar_commercials
tools.description: Commercials like a given one — by STORY (similar idea, tropes and tone) or by LOOK (similar shots: light, framing, palette). Accepts the same filters as search_commercials to narrow (e.g. only award winners, only another brand).

tools.description: More shots that look like the given shot ids (from earlier results or a shot list) — the refine loop: "more like #2". Takes the same shot tags and commercial filters to steer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_frames, get_frame_details, get_commercial · Private data: search_frames, commercials_profile · Public sink: get_commercial · Destructive: commercials_stats.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_frames, get_frame_details, get_commercial · Private data: search_frames, commercials_profile · Public sink: get_commercial · Destructive: commercials_stats

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_commercial_shots" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find individual SHOTS inside commercials by what is in the frame ("hand pouring beer in slow motion", "car drifting at night in the rain", "family laughing at a kitchen table"), with shot tags (size, angle, setting, time of day, lighting, mood, people, product / logo visible) and any commercial-leve" → after: "Find individual SHOTS inside commercials by what is in the frame ("hand pouring beer in slow motion", "car drifting at night in the rain", "family laughing at a kitchen table"), with shot tags (size, angle, setting, time of day, lighting, mood, people, product / logo visible) and any commercial-leve"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
